videos.title: A Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
videos.description: Born in a predominantly Hindu and Sheik nation, the odds of becoming a Christian were slim to none. Having experienced the truth of Christ in his life, Ivan Raj sheds light on two interconnected practices: Yoga and Hinduism.

videos.title: Tomorrow in 30 Minutes
videos.description: In this presentation, Pr Mike Browning explores the profound connection between our origins and our identity. He argues that humanity is not a biological accident but a purposeful creation by God, and he highlights the Seventh-day Sabbath as the enduring sign of that relationship.

videos.title: Pillars of Faith
videos.description: Better than a Known Way C. A. Murray.

videos.title: 3ABN Australia Homecoming
videos.description: The greatest Last Days event, prior to the second coming of Jesus, is not merely the unfolding of prophetic signs, but a manifestation of Christ’s character of love in His people. As we daily surrender to God’s transforming work, patiently allowing Him to cultivate Christlikeness in us, we hasten the return of Jesus by becoming living testimonies that draw the world to the Saviour. This inward work of the Spirit is the true climactic event that ripens the harvest of the world and ushers in the second coming of Jesus.

videos.title: Unshackled Purpose
videos.description: Did you know that you hold the same amount of value as the richest man in the world? Tune in to find out what this is all about.

videos.title: Intimate Clarity
videos.description: Humanity started out naked and not ashamed, but the fall led to our enduring sense of body shame. While covering our bodies is appropriate, extreme shame of our physical self is unhealthy. In marriage, we recover that naked-and-not-ashamed experience, which symbolizes our spiritual intimacy with God.

videos.title: Multitude of Counselors
videos.description: A Mother’s Tears and how to cope with a sudden loss in the family. Join Jennifer Jill Schwirzer and the Counselors, for an interview with Pat Arrabito. On the topic of grief.

videos.title: Lineage
videos.description: These chapters cover progress of reform in Germany and the birth of the term Protestant and then the story of the reformation in France, England, the Netherlands and Scandinavia. Despite being lesser known, each of these countries had some brave and courageous leaders whose stories inspire us today.

videos.title: Tiny Tots for Jesus
videos.description: Jesus Forgives His Friends Linda Johnson.

videos.title: The Creation Case
videos.description: There are many things in nature that look old but everyone knows that the things on our planet don’t come with a tag that tells us how old things are. Headquarters knows that the evidence must be interpreted and when Rich compares what we see in nature to earth’s most reliable historical sourcebook, The Bible, we discover amazing things about the past.

videos.title: Recipes from Russia
videos.description: An update from 3ABN Russia along with a recipe of potatoes and mushrooms cooked in clay pots with edible “lids.”.

videos.title: Impact Hope
videos.description: Episode 7 of this 13 part documentary highlights Impact Hope's innovative approach to assisting students post-graduation by addressing the critical need for employment through the provision of micro-loans. This installment focuses on four graduates who, with the support and guidance from Impact Hope, utilize a micro-loan to establish a successful bakery business. It showcases their entrepreneurial journey, underscoring the importance of financial empowerment in fostering self-sufficiency and economic growth within the refugee community.

videos.title: AWR360 Broadcast to Baptism
videos.description: Adventist World Radio’s latest documentary is a testament to answering the call to deliver AWR's Godpods deep into a war zone. Front Lines of Hope documents the journey of Greg, Brock and Dylan— ordinary fathers from the U.S. bringing hope to Ukraine’s war-torn front lines. This inspiring film explores the connection between fatherhood, creating change, and the power of prayer in times of crisis.

videos.title: The Creation Case
videos.description: The mountain ranges around the world are beautiful and mysterious at the same time. What causes mountains to form? Why do we find marine fossils at the top of many mountains? Come along as Rich uncovers clues that help us understand earth’s dramatic history.

videos.title: People Just Like Us
videos.description: Jesus told many parables while He was on earth. He used every day articles and occupations, such as catching fish, or sowing seed--ordinary things that anyone could remember--to help us understand the Kingdom of God and how to be saved from our sins. In today's program we will discuss one of the most well known of His parables and find out how to get out of the pigpen of life. Although this is a story, its lesson is real and applies to everyone of us. No one is exempt. This information is for you!

videos.title: 3ABN Today
videos.description: Join host John Dinzey and Liz Thomsen from Child Impact International as they reveal how mission, donor, and medical trips transform both the communities served and the hearts of those who go. Discover how firsthand experiences in countries like Thailand, Zambia, Pakistan, and the Philippines create lifelong advocates for vulnerable children—and learn how a simple willingness to "come and see" can multiply your faith, broaden your worldview, and leave an eternal legacy.

videos.title: Spotless
videos.description: In Episode 7 of SPOTLESS, Shelley Quinn takes us through the rest of the biblical account of the great patriarchs of Genesis. Your eyes will be opened to understand why Abraham (and the strapping young Isaac) had the faith to submit to God’s strange request of human sacrifice that was purely a test of loyalty. Follow the twists and turns of the dramatic life accounts of Isaac, Jacob, and Joseph, and see how God’s gracious intervention helped them endure hardships, and brought them into covenant relationship with Him so that they could inherit His blessings. videos.title: 3ABN Now
videos.description: This is part 2 of Graham Weir's incredible testimony of how his childhood hearing loss didn't hold him back from achieving many goals in life. Unfortunately, even as an adult, he continued to encounter prejudice against hearing impaired people in education. But, Graham can truly say he has seen God's hand in his life journey. Watch his testimony and be blessed by someone that God has touched, guided, and used for His glory. Even when faced with a sudden disability, God could step in and use Graham to help many other people.

videos.title: Celebrating Life in Recovery
videos.description: The Test Of Discipleship Ron and Celeste Lee, Cheri Peters.

videos.title: The Creator Revealed
videos.description: DNA is amazing, but what exactly is it? What does it do in every living thing? Why is DNA just the right material for the function it performs? Why does just about everyone who studies it acknowledge that DNA at least looks designed? Are there good reasons for Darwinists to deny that DNA is evidence of design? What does DNA tell us about the Creator who wrote out the instructions for life in this remarkable molecule?

videos.title: Made for Health
videos.description: Join Risë Rafferty, MS, RDN, and a team of top health experts as they dive into the fascinating world of gut health. Learn how various lifestyle factors affect the community of microbes in your digestive system and what you can do to optimize your gut microbiome.

videos.title: Digital Disconnect
videos.description: Have we all gone mad? These stats, trends, and even physiological effects of non-stop media have reached such absurd levels that they would be hilarious if they weren’t so deadly – and they now have even the biggest promoters of media use running for the exits.

What would the congregation think? Would Todd lose his job? And if so, where would he work? Learn how the Lord preserved their family in the midst of this tremendous struggle.

videos.title: Your Lifestyle As Medicine
videos.description: The healing influence of nature is being increasingly recognised. The benefits of light exposure, forest therapy, and green spaces are some highlights of this emerging area of research. This program explores some of the evidence for nature as medicine, possible mechanisms, exposure recommendations and practical suggestions.

videos.description: In Revelation 22, John spoke of the river of the water of life flowing from the throne of God. Imagine yourself as part of that great crowd standing on the banks singing Shall We Gather At the River, Jesus Loves Me, and Shout To the Lord. Host Tim Parton and guest John Lomacang lead your favorites songs and share the reality of a relationship with Christ, while you are invited to worship along. Then send more requests to tim.parton@3abn.org.
